items.text: changed: while you edit, the Halo, Colour and Shape switches moved to the right rail under the clipboard buttons (icons only). The colours and the shapes are now two rows of round buttons in the same eight columns, so each colour sits directly over a shape. That frees the row they used under the stage.

changed: the cell Halo is now one solid frame, no bigger than the grid squares around the cell: the eight marks as icons only, thin lines between them, the cell itself left visible in the middle (tap it for its next colour). The name of the square under your finger shows above the frame, and the square you press grows so it is easy to hit.

fixed: a quick double tap no longer zooms the screen on iPhone and iPad. The page now blocks the zoom itself, drops the second tap of a fast double tap (your two-finger and ring double taps still work), and snaps back if a zoom ever gets through.

changed: while you edit, the colour buttons moved from the left rail into the edit bar under the Halo, Colour and Shape switches, with the shapes in a row below them. The three switches, the colours and the shapes that go together now sit together, and the rail keeps only the edit tools.

changed: Halo now uses the same ring as Current. In pencil mode, tap a cell and its eight marks (none, short, held, glide up, glide down, soft, two quick, accent) open as round dots around it, with the cell left visible in the middle; the colour is one more dot that opens its own ring. Choosing a mark or colour changes the cell and the ring stays open, so you can try several. The Halo button wears Current's six-dot ring mark instead of the old grid symbol.

fixed: with eight colours the colour buttons on the left rail stretched into tall slabs that ran past the frame. They are a fixed, shorter size now (two columns of four, 34 px each), so the whole set fits.

fixed: the heads-up display no longer slides sideways. Three panes were a little wider than the phone (the line-up chips in Lines and dice, the device list in MIDI, a long button in Performance), so swiping nudged the whole pane left and cut off its words. Those now wrap to fit, and a pane can no longer scroll sideways at all.
fixed: the left and right arrows in the heads-up footer looked lit for no reason. They were picking up the general button look; they are plain again.

fixed: in the heads-up display's Sounds pane the Sound set, Texture and Morph to rows had collapsed to thin lines, so you could not see or tap their buttons. They show in full again and wrap to the pane's width.
changed: the Sounds tab has its own icon, two waves (a voice and its texture), instead of the heads-up display's screen icon.
